universal.prompt: What is the user doing in the 10 seconds before this screen appears?
What single job must this screen complete — in one verb?
If this product were a person, how do they speak — not how they look?
What must this NOT remind users of? (competitors, templates, references you studied)
When the user clicks or toggles, what specifically moves or morphs? (price digits, meta fade, row hover — name each micro-interaction)
Finish honestly: "This looks like ___ with different copy." If you can name it, reject and restart.

auth.prompt: Should this moment feel trust, speed, or calm — and why for THIS product?
What happens when the code is wrong? One clear escape.

portfolio.prompt: What is the ONE thing a visitor should remember after 30 seconds?

hero.prompt: What single idea lands in 5 seconds before anyone reads subcopy?

404.prompt: What does 'not found' mean in this brand's world — not generically?

pricing.prompt: Which plan should the eye hit first — and is that honest for the business?
Billing toggle changes the price — will digits morph with NumberFlow, or will you swap text? (Must morph.)

landing.prompt: What story does this section tell in one glance — without a feature grid?
